verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at cua.ai/llms.txt and a markdown docs endpoint at cua.ai/docs.md, both returning HTTP 200. A further docs/llms.txt index describes product areas in agent-readable summaries, so a user can point an agent straight at Cua's agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no independent community or hands-on report of agents actually consuming these files.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://cua.ai/llms.txt # Cua
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://cua.ai/docs.md # Cua Docs
Cua Driver: lets an agent drive native apps on macOS, Windows and Linux in the background, through MCP or a CLI.
